data.explanation: Malerbetrieb Muster has billed you for painting three rooms in your flat, completed on 12 August 2026. The total is €1,130.50 including VAT. Pay by bank transfer within 14 days of receiving the invoice; the app shows the deadline. The invoice has no date, so check when you received it. Keep it: work done in your home (Handwerkerleistungen) may be partly deductible on your tax return if paid by bank transfer, but check whether that applies to your rented flat.
